Not all pictures in the pool for a given type are being made available to any track to “see” and maybe pin. The desired result is that a user can browse any of the pictures based on type and then “pin” the picture(s) that they would like to be saved to a given track (selected or all). De-pinning a picture should not remove the picture from the available list of pictures it just means don’t save that picture to the track’s file. Also, when a track is loaded/added any pictures it has already in its file should be initially pinned. If when loading/adding a track the pictures coming from the file of that track already exists in the pool then that track gets a reference to the existing pooled picture and it is initially pinned as if natively contributed. In this way tracks loaded/added will not lose or gain pictures if no picture pinning changes have been made and the file is saved. It may be necessary to update the code to keep track of what pictures a given track file started with so that at time of save if effectively no changes were made that would change a track file’s picture content, then the pictures will not need to be rewritten.
